name: haxtheweb-desktop
description: HAX Electron app to run haxcms-nodejs via desktop app launcher
author: HAXTheWeb core team

scripts.release: npm run build && commit-and-tag-version && git push --follow-tags origin master && npm publish
scripts.pack-deb64: npm run build && cd .. && ./haxcms-desktop/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager ./haxcms-desktop/ haxtheweb-desktop --executable-name=haxtheweb-desktop --out=./haxcms-desktop/builds --platform linux --arch x64 --icon=./haxcms-desktop/dist/src/favicon.ico --ignore="^(?!(.*node_modules|.*dist))(.*src.*|.*screenshots.*|.*tsconfig.*|.*_sites.*|.*_published.*|.*_archived.*|.*builds.*|.*README.*|.*git.*|.*haxcmsconfig.*)" --ignore=".*locutus.*/(php/bc|esm/php/bc)/.*" --no-asar --overwrite && cd haxcms-desktop && npm run fixbuildissue-deb64 && node scripts/flip-fuses.mjs builds/haxtheweb-desktop-linux-x64/haxtheweb-desktop
scripts.pack-win32: npm run build && cd .. && ./haxcms-desktop/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager ./haxcms-desktop/ haxtheweb-desktop --executable-name=haxtheweb-desktop --out=./haxcms-desktop/builds --platform win32 --arch x64 --icon=./haxcms-desktop/dist/src/favicon.ico --ignore="^(?!(.*node_modules|.*dist))(.*src.*|.*screenshots.*|.*tsconfig.*|.*_sites.*|.*_published.*|.*_archived.*|.*builds.*|.*README.*|.*git.*|.*haxcmsconfig.*)" --ignore=".*locutus.*/(php/bc|esm/php/bc)/.*" --no-asar --overwrite && cd haxcms-desktop && npm run fixbuildissue-win32 && node scripts/flip-fuses.mjs builds/haxtheweb-desktop-win32-x64/haxtheweb-desktop.exe
scripts.pack-darwin: npm run build && cd .. && ./haxcms-desktop/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager ./haxcms-desktop/ haxtheweb-desktop --executable-name=haxtheweb-desktop --out=./haxcms-desktop/builds --platform darwin --arch x64 --icon=./haxcms-desktop/dist/src/favicon.ico --ignore="^(?!(.*node_modules|.*dist))(.*src.*|.*screenshots.*|.*tsconfig.*|.*_sites.*|.*_published.*|.*_archived.*|.*builds.*|.*README.*|.*git.*|.*haxcmsconfig.*)" --ignore=".*locutus.*/(php/bc|esm/php/bc)/.*" --no-asar --overwrite && cd haxcms-desktop && npm run fixbuildissue-darwin && node scripts/flip-fuses.mjs builds/haxtheweb-desktop-darwin-x64/haxtheweb-desktop.app
scripts.pack-darwin-arm64: npm run build && cd .. && ./haxcms-desktop/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager ./haxcms-desktop/ haxtheweb-desktop --executable-name=haxtheweb-desktop --out=./haxcms-desktop/builds --platform darwin --arch arm64 --icon=./haxcms-desktop/dist/src/favicon.ico --ignore="^(?!(.*node_modules|.*dist))(.*src.*|.*screenshots.*|.*tsconfig.*|.*_sites.*|.*_published.*|.*_archived.*|.*builds.*|.*README.*|.*git.*|.*haxcmsconfig.*)" --ignore=".*locutus.*/(php/bc|esm/php/bc)/.*" --no-asar --overwrite && cd haxcms-desktop && npm run fixbuildissue-darwin-arm64 && node scripts/flip-fuses.mjs builds/haxtheweb-desktop-darwin-arm64/haxtheweb-desktop.app
